name: Sublet key
summary: A summer sublet as a key tag: dates and price on the front, the answers to the questions everyone keeps asking on the back (tap to flip); interested people hang on a pegboard of hooks with their mutual friends, and the host hands the key to one of them.
useWhen: people keep asking the same questions about my sublet
who should i sublet my room to this summer
summer sublet, furnished, utilities included, dm me
picking a subletter from everyone who's interested
dontUseWhen: looking for a sublet yourself (use sublet-finder)
matching roommates for next year (use roommate-match)

room.description: Short description of the room and where

faq.description: Up to 4 repeated questions: q (short), a (the answer), asked (how many times)

hooks.description: Up to 5 interested people already on hooks: who, mutual friends count, and a short line
